scope: examples/cross_characteristic_ecdlp; target field size 2^256, subgroup order 7; coordinates defined over F4; abstract transfer without a general efficient evaluator
statement: For every integer k, S = [k]R on y^2+omega*y=x^3+omega*x^2 over GaloisField 2 256 if and only if Q = [k]P on y^2-x*y-4*y=x^3-4*x^2 over F_65537, for the stated order-seven points and a primitive cube root omega.
